crossRefs.note: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t…
He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?’ But you…
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
“ ‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known…
He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse…

translations.web: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
translations.bsb: A partner to a thief hates his own soul; he receives the oath but does not testify.
translations.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth
translations.asv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul; He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.
